newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank one-week refinancing funds up.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank one-week refinancing funds up.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said it had raised the one-week refinancing funds on offer at Thursday's auction by 370 billion lei to 1.55 trillion lei.
Its one-week minimum permitted rate was flat at 48 percent.
Traders said they could not grasp the reasons behind the recent upward move in the BNR funds available on the background of an overliquid money market.
BNR officials were not immediately available for comment.
Last week, the central bank raised the amount of one-week funds on offer to 1.18 trillion lei from 1.045 trillion.
Short-term money market rates were near 43 percent.
Auction results are expected on FXRP later on Thursday or early on Friday. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
